app.name: Kata-Kata
app.subtitle: Malay word dojo
home.today_empty: You're done for today. Practise again to meet new words.
home.streak_rest: A rest day won't break it
home.ios_banner: You're in a Safari tab. Add Kata-Kata to your Home Screen so your progress is kept.
home.backup_banner: You haven't backed up for over a week.
onb.welcome_body: Kata-Kata helps you learn Malay words a little every day. Prepare before class, review after class.
onb.kancil: Your guide is Sang Kancil, the small, clever mouse-deer of Malay folk tales.
onb.name_body: Used only in the file you send to your teacher. It never leaves this device otherwise.
onb.voice_body: Tap play and check that you can hear Malay.
onb.voice_ms: A Malay voice was found on this device.
onb.voice_id: No Malay voice, so an Indonesian voice is used instead. Some words sound slightly different.
onb.voice_none: This device has no Malay voice. You can still learn from the text. Adding a Malay voice in your device settings will turn audio on.
onb.voice_volume: Check your volume and silent switch. If you still hear nothing, tap "I can't hear it".
onb.ios_body: Safari on iPhone can delete a site's data after seven days without a visit. Apps added to the Home Screen are exempt.
onb.ios_step1: Tap the Share button (square with an arrow)
onb.ios_step3: Open Kata-Kata from your Home Screen
onb.how_1: Do "Today's practice" for about 10 minutes a day.
onb.how_2: Mistakes are fine. The word simply comes back later.
onb.how_3: Stuck? Tap "I don't know", then "Ask teacher".
onb.how_4: Your progress stays on this device only.
sess.quit_confirm: Stop practising? Everything so far is saved.
sess.recall: Say it in Malay, then check the answer.
sum.title: Bagus! Well done!
sum.tip_hard: Your hardest words will come back soon.
sum.tip_daily: Try 10 minutes again tomorrow. A little every day works best.
sum.tip_sedia: Before your next class, try Class prep.
game.kad.name: Kad Kata (word cards)
game.kad.howto: See and hear the Malay, then pick the meaning. Some cards show the meaning and you say the Malay.
game.cari.name: Cari Benda (find it)
game.cari.howto: Listen to the Malay word and tap that thing in the picture.
game.susun.name: Susun Ayat (build it)
game.susun.howto: Put the word tiles in the right order to build the sentence.
game.susun.example: Example: Nama · saya · Tanaka. → "Nama saya Tanaka."
howto.title: How to play
sedia.title: Class prep
sedia.body: Meeting the words before class leaves more class time for speaking.
main.title: Mini-games
main.need_words: You haven't learned any words yet. Start with Today's practice.
main.phase2: Laju, Jaring, Cakap and Kedai Tanaka arrive in the next version.
tanya.title: Ask teacher
tanya.body: Save questions to ask in class.
tanya.empty: No questions yet. You can also ask from any word card.
tanya.text_ph: Write in Japanese, English or Malay
report.title: Report a problem
report.text_ph: What's wrong, and how would you fix it?
report.saved: Saved. It goes to your teacher with "Send to teacher".
send.title: Send to teacher
send.body: Check what will be sent. Untick anything you'd rather keep private.
send.note: Nothing is ever sent automatically. Next you choose WhatsApp, LINE, email or similar.
send.downloaded: File saved. Send it to your teacher by WhatsApp, LINE or email.
send.name: Your name (used in the file name)
rekod.title: Records
rekod.save_body: Move your progress between phone and PC, or keep a backup.
rekod.replace_confirm: This deletes all progress on this device and replaces it with the file. This can't be undone. Continue?
rekod.checksum_bad: This file is damaged or was edited, so it can't be loaded.
rekod.name: Name
rekod.storage_no: Storage protection: not granted. Back up regularly.
rekod.reset_confirm: This deletes all progress, questions and stamps on this device. It can't be undone. Export a savefile first. Delete everything?
rekod.privacy: No accounts, no analytics, no server. Your data leaves this device only when you export it.
jaring.title: Word web
jaring.body: Your words and how they connect. Tap a word to add your own hook.
tip.final: Close the final consonant, no extra vowel (makan, not makanu)
tip.rl: Keep r and l apart (r is rolled)
tip.ng: ng and ny are nasal sounds
pos.label: Part of speech
onb.lang_body: You can change this later in Records → Settings.
